item.title: [7.0] Evo-Bench: Can Language Models Improve Agent Harness?
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Large Language Models (LLMs) have driven rapid progress in autonomous agents, yet standard evaluations remain confined to static task solving. An emerging frontier is harness evolution---the agent's capacity to autonomously optimize its own operating harness. However, systematically benchmarking this capability remains challenging, as existing evaluations fail to isolate harness improvements...

WHY IT MATTERS

Evo-Bench introduces a novel framework for evaluating LLM agent harness evolution, addressing a critical gap in isolating self-optimization capabilities from base model strength.
